# Copilot Instructions — Computer Use Workbench (Modernization)

> Generated by the doc-and-modernize skill (Modernization mode). This is a
> **sibling** file to the existing `.github/copilot-instructions.md` (which
> holds an unrelated "caveman" response-style guide) — it was not overwritten.
> See `MODERNIZATION_PLAN.md` §7 for the reconciliation decision this project
> still needs to make between the two files.

Computer Use Workbench is **not** a legacy-rescue case. It is already
post-testability ("lit") for every component — backend, frontend, and Docker
sandbox all install from committed lockfiles, build on the current toolchain,
boot, and pass their test/scan gates in CI on every push and PR to `main`. The
current `MODERNIZATION_PLAN.md` is a single, small cleanup phase (dead code,
a duplicate manifest, a deprecated env-var alias, doc-drift), not a rescue
plan. See `MODERNIZATION_PLAN.md` for the full rationale and
`docs/codebase/ARCHITECTURE.md` for the audited current state.

## Commands

| Action | Command |
|--------|---------|
| Install / restore deps (backend) | `uv sync --frozen` |
| Install / restore deps (frontend) | `npm --prefix frontend ci` |
| Run dev stack | `uv run python dev.py --open-browser` |
| Run backend only | `uv run python -m backend.main` |
| Unit tests (backend, all) | `uv run pytest -p no:warnings --tb=short --cov=backend --cov-report=term-missing --cov-fail-under=60` |
| Single test file (backend) | `uv run pytest path/to/test_foo.py` |
| Live-provider tests (opt-in) | `uv run pytest -m integration` |
| Offline evals | `uv run pytest -p no:warnings --tb=short -o addopts='' evals/` |
| Unit tests (frontend, all) | `npm --prefix frontend run test:run` |
| Lint (backend) | `uv run ruff check .` |
| Format check (backend) | `uv run ruff format --check .` |
| Typecheck (backend) | `uv run mypy` |
| Lint (frontend) | `npm --prefix frontend run lint` |
| Typecheck (frontend) | `npm --prefix frontend run typecheck` |
| Build (frontend) | `npm --prefix frontend run build` |
| Container build + scan | `docker build -f docker/Dockerfile .` then Trivy HIGH/CRITICAL |

CI (`.github/workflows/ci.yml`) runs `python-quality` (ruff → format →
mypy → pip-audit) → `python-tests` (pytest, matrix Python 3.12/3.13/3.14) →
`frontend` (lint → typecheck → test:run → build → npm audit) → `container`
(build + Trivy scan) on every push and PR to `main`. This gate has existed
since before the current modernization plan — there is no new "CI Milestone"
in this plan; it operates entirely inside the existing gate. **Enforcement is
a separate manual step:** whether this workflow is a required status check /
branch-protection rule on `main` is `[UNVERIFIED]` from the local checkout —
confirm at GitHub → Settings → Branches.

## Phase gating

This plan has exactly **one** phase (Phase 1, cleanup), fully in the lit
regime. Its exit criteria are the existing CI gate passing unmodified, plus a
grep-based confirmation that the two removed dead artifacts have zero
remaining references. There is no dark-regime work and no second phase to
gate into.

## Decisions

- `CUA_WS_TOKEN` removal is **deferred, not dropped** — Phase 1 only adds a
  deprecation warning and a CHANGELOG entry; an actual removal version is an
  open decision (`MODERNIZATION_PLAN.md` §9.1).
- Update `MODERNIZATION_PLAN.md`'s Phase 1 checklist as each exit criterion
  is met.

## Branching & PRs

Single branch (e.g. `chore/dead-code-and-doc-drift-cleanup`) cut from `main`,
one PR, merged on green CI. No phase stacking — there is only one phase, so
the usual trunk-drift hazard (H7) does not apply here. Trunk is confirmed
`main`; no legacy `master` branch exists in this checkout.

**Keep the executable docs alive with the code.** Phase 1 task 1.4 updates
`docs/codebase/ARCHITECTURE.md` and `STACK.md`'s stale version/snapshot lines
in the *same* PR as the code changes they describe (H8 compliance) — do not
split this into a follow-up.

> **CI enforcement is a manual, human-only step.** Confirming or enabling
> required-status-check / branch-protection on `main` is a GitHub
> Settings → Branches action this file cannot perform.
